verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a built-in workspace data export for backups or migration and explicitly promises 'no lock-in'. Self-hosting gives end-to-end data ownership. However, the export is capped at 20,000 records per export, and the docs never state the export file format. Missing for 10: explicit open export format (e.g., CSV/JSON) documentation, a full-workspace export without the 20k-record limit (including relations, emails and metadata), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your workspace data for backups, reporting, or migration. ... Export limits: Up to 20,000 records per export.
